title: [Main]- Project Planning Lines are created in reverse order when purchase line descriptions are copied
summary: Fix project planning lines being created in reverse order when posting purchase invoices with copy line descriptions enabled.
key_points: Project Planning Lines now follow the original purchase line order instead of reverse order
Occurs when Copy Line Descr. to G/L Entry is enabled and several G/L Account lines share a project and task
Cause: Invoice Posting Buffer groups were processed in descending order of a key that includes the source line number
Purch. Post Invoice now processes buffer groups in ascending source line order across all layers
Intended not to change G/L, VAT or Job Ledger Entry posting; job consumption tests updated
quote: Project Planning Lines are created in reverse order when purchase line descriptions are copied
